mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_NO AS bannerNo, TITLE AS title, LINK_URL AS linkUrl FROM OFT_MAIN_BANNER WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, PI.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo FROM OFT_PRODUCT P JOIN OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND P.SALE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC

WITH latest_match AS ( SELECT ppm.PRODUCT_NO, ps.AVG_PRICE, ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ppm.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH ppm JOIN OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT ps ON ps.SNAPSHOT_NO = ppm.SNAPSHOT_NO ), main_image AS ( SELECT pi.PRODUCT_NO, pi.IMAGE_NO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.IS_MAIN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, pi.IMAGE_NO ASC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRODUCT_IMAGE pi ) SELECT productNo, productName, salePrice, avgPrice, imageNo, imageUrl FROM ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, lm.AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, mi.IMAGE_NO AS imageNo, CASE WHEN mi.IMAGE_NO IS NOT NULL THEN '/api/image/product/' || mi.IMAGE_NO ELSE '' END AS imageUrl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN lm.AVG_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND lm.AVG_PRICE > 0 AND p.SALE_PRICE < lm.AVG_PRICE THEN ((lm.AVG_PRICE - p.SALE_PRICE) / lm.AVG_PRICE) ELSE 0 END DESC, p.UPDATED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PRODUCT_NO DESC ) AS rowNo FROM OFT_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN latest_match lm ON lm.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND lm.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN main_image mi ON mi.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND mi.rn = 1 WHERE p.IS_SEASONAL = 'Y' AND p.SALE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ) WHERE rowNo <= #{limit} ORDER BY rowNo

SELECT recipeNo, recipeName FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY NVL(rv.reviewCount, 0) DESC, r.RECIPE_NO DESC ) AS rowNo FROM OFT_RECIPE r JOIN OFT_RECIPE_INGREDIENT ri ON ri.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_NO, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM OFT_REVIEW WHERE RECIPE_NO IS NOT NULL AND DELETED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY RECIPE_NO ) rv ON rv.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO WHERE UPPER(ri.INGREDIENT_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{productName}) || '%' ) WHERE rowNo <= #{limit} ORDER BY rowNo

SELECT recipeNo, recipeName, imageUrl FROM ( SELECT r.RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, r.RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, r.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY NVL(rv.reviewCount, 0) DESC, r.RECIPE_NO DESC ) AS rowNo FROM OFT_RECIPE r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RECIPE_NO, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM OFT_REVIEW WHERE RECIPE_NO IS NOT NULL AND DELETED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY RECIPE_NO ) rv ON rv.RECIPE_NO = r.RECIPE_NO ) WHERE rowNo <= #{limit} ORDER BY rowNo
